item.title: Thanks Peasedown Parish Council for Supporting Local Digital Broadcasting - Somer Valley

item.title: Retrofit West Home Energy Fair
item.description: Somer Valley headed down to Retrofit West’s Home Energy Fair for a special one-hour show, packed with expert advice on making homes greener, warmer, and more energy-efficient!

item.title: Somerset Day 2025 - Somer Valley
item.description: Somer Valley FM is right behind Somerset Day on Sunday 11th May. Hear the voices of our young presenters celebrate their county in this Sound Vision Somerset Day Special.

item.title: Somer Valley wins King’s Award for Voluntary Service
item.description: Somer Valley FM has been awarded the prestigious King’s Award for Voluntary Service — the highest honour bestowed upon volunteer groups in the UK

item.title: Live from the Farm! - Somer Valley
item.description: We celebrate Somer Valley Farms 3rd birthday! On the show, we get a in-depth tour of the farm and are also treated to some fantastic live music!
